trails.name: Dipsea Trail
trails.blurb: The legendary Mill Valley–to–Stinson Beach classic, and the oldest trail race route in the country.

trails.name: Tennessee Valley Trail
trails.address: Tennessee Valley Rd, Mill Valley, CA 94941
trails.blurb: A flat, easy out-and-back through open valley to a secluded cove beach.

trails.name: Cataract Falls Trail
trails.address: Rock Spring, Ridgecrest Blvd, Mill Valley, CA 94941
trails.blurb: A string of waterfalls along Cataract Creek, best after rain, running through the Mt Tamalpais watershed.

trails.name: Steep Ravine Trail
trails.blurb: A short, steep redwood-canyon trail — the only one in Marin with a built-in ladder.

trails.name: Matt Davis Trail
trails.blurb: Golden hillsides and coastal panoramas between Stinson Beach and Pantoll — a locals' favorite.

trails.name: Phoenix Lake Loop
trails.address: Natalie Coffin Greene Park, Lagunitas Rd, Ross, CA 94957
trails.blurb: A gentle loop around a historic reservoir in Kentfield — flat, shaded, and close to home.

trails.name: Old Railroad Grade
trails.address: Blithedale Ridge / Fern Canyon Rd, Mill Valley, CA 94941
trails.blurb: A gradual, historic climb to East Peak along the old "Crookedest Railroad in the World" route.

trails.name: Muir Woods Main Trail
trails.address: 1 Muir Woods Rd, Mill Valley, CA 94941
trails.blurb: A flat, paved loop through old-growth redwoods along Redwood Creek — the easiest way to feel the scale of the forest.
